description: Verify that DUT TCP keeps the connection open and emits zero-window probes indefinitely as long as the tester acknowledges each probe (RFC 1122 §4.2.2.17)
approach:
[Objective]
When the peer's window is 0, DUT must persist with zero-window probes until the window opens. As long as ACKs come, DUT keeps probing — no give-up.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Handshake; DUT sends data segment #1; tester acks but advertises zero window.
2. DUT → Tester: zero-window probe #1.
3. Tester → DUT: ACK (still zero window).
4. DUT → Tester: probe #2 → ACK → probe #3.

[Pass condition]
All 3 probes observed.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_seg1 — first data segment missing
• Fail_no_probe<n> — probe n missing

verdicts.Fail_no_probe2: No DUT zero-window probe 2 after ACK
verdicts.Fail_no_probe3: No DUT zero-window probe 3 after ACK
